exposure: Newborns and mothers who gave birth between 2012 and 2019 in a third-level regional hospital
an Apgar score lower than 7 at birth
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding in the delivery room
cohort: 11,285 women and newborns, of which 302 (2.6%) used ART
finding: The use of ART was a negative predictor of exclusive breastfeeding both in the delivery room and at hospital discharge.
mod_finding: The use of assisted reproduction techniques (ART) was identified as a negative predictor of exclusive breastfeeding upon hospital discharge.
